counting_convention: 1 working set = 1.0 to each prime mover, 0.5 to each clear synergist (bucket_muscle_map; per-exercise overrides are stored on each component). Every movement inside a superset/complex counts its own sets (a 4-movement complex done 3 times = 3 sets in each of its buckets). Unilateral 'x/x', 'x & x', 'x*x' = 1 set per round (not doubled). Medball 'ALL LIST' / 'SEE LIST' = 1 set of every throw in the list (19 sets). AP_* sets are reported as 'athletic exposure' and are NOT counted toward hypertrophy muscle volume (same convention as prog_byop_athletic.volume.json). Conditioning is counted as rounds/minutes. working_sets = all non-throw, non-conditioning component sets (RP + ISO + core + AP excluding AP_THROW). 'as_written' uses only numeric SETS cells; 'assumed' fills the two non-numeric athletic cells ('TABATA' -> 4 bouts per exercise; '2 to 4' -> 3).
contact_counting: 1 rep of a jump / hop / landing = 1 lower-body ground contact; per-leg reps are summed ('40 & 40' = 80). Tiers: high = depth jumps/drops, box/high/tuck/broad/squat/lunge/step-up/march/hex-bar/DB jumps; low = squirrel jumps, plate jumps, small hops, high-knee reps inside a complex; time = time-prescribed drills, ESTIMATED (High Knee Runs FAST 3.5 contacts/s, jump rope 2 contacts/s) and kept out of the totals; upper = plyo push-up hand contacts. Medball throws are counted separately as throws.

cross_program_comparison.plyo_question: Coach claim: boxers need fewer plyos than basketball/MMA. In these two tabs the boxer's weeks 3-8 carry 113-129 high-intensity + 142-177 low-amplitude lower-body contacts per week (258-306 total, plus an estimated 720-1440 jump-rope contacts) versus the athletic tab's 146 / 191 / 132 total contacts per week for Starting / Mid / Advanced. So, measured as contacts, the boxing example is NOT lower than the generic athletic example. The boxing difference is in timing (zero plyo in weeks 1-2), type (single-leg reactive, squirrel/jump-rope bouncing, landings) and packaging (most max-intent jumps live inside heavy-lift complexes, 5 reps each). No basketball or MMA example exists in these two tabs to test the claim directly.
cross_program_comparison.notes: athletic share of working sets = AP sets (excl. throws) / all non-throw working sets
